difficulty_why: A dedicated developer sandbox account is required to access Developer Hub and create an OAuth app, but private apps can be shared with any customer immediately without review.

dev_time.label: 15-30 min
dev_time.text: Time to register a free developer sandbox account, access Developer Hub, configure OAuth credentials, and set the private app to live status.

launch_time.label: Same day
launch_time.text: Private apps can connect external customers immediately once set to live via an unlisted install link without waiting for review. Public marketplace listings require up to 21 business days for review.

own_app_reasons.label: Custom consent branding
own_app_reasons.text: Shows your application's custom name and logo on the Pipedrive OAuth authorization consent screen instead of a generic third-party name.

own_app_reasons.label: Tailored scope management
own_app_reasons.text: Allows configuring exact OAuth access scopes matching your application's requirements.

app_type.label: Private App
app_type.text: Register a Private App in Developer Hub. Private apps can be set to live and installed by external customer accounts via a direct installation link without requiring Marketplace review. Create a Public App only if you want to be listed publicly on the Pipedrive Marketplace.

prerequisites.label: Developer sandbox account
prerequisites.text: A free Pipedrive developer sandbox account is required to access Developer Hub and register apps.

prerequisites.label: No paid plan or credit card required
prerequisites.text: Creating a developer sandbox account is self-serve and does not require a paid plan or credit card.

steps.label: Sign up for developer sandbox
steps.text: Navigate to the Pipedrive developer portal and create a free developer sandbox account.

steps.label: Navigate to Developer Hub
steps.text: Log in to your sandbox account, click your profile icon in the top right corner, and select Developer Hub.

steps.label: Create private app
steps.text: Click Create an app and choose Create private app.

steps.label: Configure basic info
steps.text: In the Basic info tab, enter your App name and Callback URL, then click Save.

steps.label: Select OAuth access scopes
steps.text: Navigate to the OAuth & access scopes tab and select the scopes matching contacts:full, leads:full, mail:full, activities:full, products:full, and projects:full.

fields.label: Access scopes
fields.value: Contacts (contacts:full), Leads (leads:full), Mail (mail:full), Activities (activities:full), Products (products:full), Projects (projects:full)

steps.label: Copy client credentials
steps.text: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret from the OAuth & access scopes tab to enter into Composio.

steps.label: Change status to live
steps.text: Click the Change to live button to activate the private app so users can authenticate via OAuth.

scopes.label: Contacts scope
scopes.text: contacts:full provides full read and write access to persons and organizations without requiring a restricted scope security review.

scopes.label: Leads scope
scopes.text: leads:full provides full read and write access to leads without requiring special security review.

scopes.label: Mail scope
scopes.text: mail:full provides full access to mail threads and messages; Pipedrive does not require an external third-party security assessment.

scopes.label: Activities scope
scopes.text: activities:full provides full access to activities, types, and fields without a separate restricted scope review.

scopes.label: Products scope
scopes.text: products:full provides full access to products without restricted review.

scopes.label: Projects scope
scopes.text: projects:full provides access to project management entities without restricted review.

approval.label: When required
approval.text: App review is only required for public apps listed on the Pipedrive Marketplace; private apps do not require review and can be shared directly with any Pipedrive customer via an unlisted install link.

approval.label: Install cap before review
approval.text: No cap found. Live private apps do not require review and can be installed by any Pipedrive company or user via a direct unlisted installation link; draft apps before live status are restricted to users inside the developer sandbox account.

approval.label: Limits until reviewed
approval.text: None found. Unreviewed private apps are subject to standard Pipedrive API rate limits, but cannot be discovered via public Marketplace search, cannot receive public ratings, and cannot be switched to public status later.

approval.label: Wait
approval.text: Public app marketplace reviews take up to 21 business days. Private apps require 0 wait time.

approval.label: Cost
approval.text: Free. Developer sandbox accounts and Marketplace reviews do not charge any developer program or submission fees.

approval.label: What's checked
approval.text: For public apps, Pipedrive tests the full OAuth install and uninstall flow, handling of cancellation, token refresh logic (handling 60-minute expiry), compliance with rate limiting, error handling, and listing assets.

pitfalls.label: Developer Hub visibility
pitfalls.text: Developer Hub is only accessible inside a developer sandbox account; it is not available in standard production Pipedrive accounts.

pitfalls.label: App type cannot be changed
pitfalls.text: App type (public vs private) cannot be changed after creation; converting a private app to a marketplace listing requires registering a new app.

pitfalls.label: Single callback URL
pitfalls.text: Pipedrive supports only one callback URL per registered app.

pitfalls.label: 60-minute token expiration
pitfalls.text: OAuth access tokens expire every 60 minutes and must be renewed using the refresh token before expiry.

pitfalls.label: Sandbox inactivity deletion
pitfalls.text: Sandbox accounts are deleted if no app is created within 45 days, or if no app is made live or published within 6 months.

pitfalls.label: Per-user installation
pitfalls.text: Installations are per user rather than company-wide; each user in a company must individually authorize the app.

support.label: Developer community
support.text: Ask questions in the Pipedrive Developers' Community forum at devcommunity.pipedrive.com.

support.label: Marketplace developer support email
support.text: Email Pipedrive's developer ecosystem team at marketplace.devs@pipedrive.com.

email_subject: Inquiry on OAuth Private App distribution and Marketplace review requirements
email_body:
Hi Pipedrive Developer Support,

We are developing an integration for our AI agent product that connects users' Pipedrive accounts using OAuth 2.0 via Composio.

We would like to confirm the following regarding our app setup:
1. We plan to register a Private App to connect customer accounts via direct OAuth installation. Can any external Pipedrive organization install and authenticate with a live Private App via its direct installation link without Marketplace review?
2. Are there any install caps, user restrictions, or rate limit differences for unlisted live Private Apps compared to listed Marketplace apps?
3. If we decide to convert to or register a Public App for the Marketplace, our required scopes are: contacts:full, leads:full, mail:full, activities:full, products:full, and projects:full. Are there any restricted scope security audits or external assessments required for these scopes?

App Details:
- App Name: [Your App Name]
- Developer Account: [Your Developer Account Email]
- Redirect URI: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Company]

checks.label: Composio toolkit
checks.text: Composio has a toolkit for Pipedrive (`pipedrive`); Composio-managed OAuth app: no; auth methods: OAUTH2, API_KEY

checks.label: Authorize URL
checks.text: Authorize URL is live and rejects an unregistered client_id, so you need a real registered app

observed.label: Developer signup form fields
observed.text: The developer sandbox signup form on the developer portal asks for E-mail and First Name without asking for credit card details.

observed.label: Developer signup self-serve
observed.text: Developer sandbox signup is directly accessible and self-serve on the developer portal landing page.

observed.label: Developer docs accessible without login
observed.text: The app creation and OAuth documentation pages are publicly readable without requiring an account or login.
